stem: Which quotation foreshadows the end of the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint”?
instruction: Use “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: She will know exactly the moment he sets down his next word on that top sheet of paper. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: “Maybe she’s a writer,” Desmond’s wife whispered to him. . . . (paragraph 2)

options.label: H
options.text: “And I can’t write with someone sitting waiting.” (paragraph 3)

options.label: J
options.text: “Adjust,” his wife said, and flicked at his nose. (paragraph 4)
